rules: Final App Store creative must come from real native release UI.
Web smoke screenshots are implementation evidence only, not App Store creative.
Do not composite Home Screen widget placements.
Widget screenshots must come from real WidgetKit surfaces.
Every claim must reinforce semester setup, review before save, focus, and widgets without unsupported LMS or automation claims.
